_doc: Copy this file to profile/preferences.json. The pipeline reads it to decide which jobs to surface vs. ignore, and where to look for new ones.
email_for_applications: <TODO: you@gmail.com — the address the pipeline sends applications from>
email_for_outreach_from: <TODO: same address (or different if you separate cold outreach)>
do_not_send_from: <TODO: any work / personal emails the pipeline must NEVER use>

salary_anchor._doc: Set both currencies if you're open to remote-international. Leave one set to 0 if you only want local offers.

preferred: <TODO: company names or types you'd love to join, e.g. 'YC startups', 'AI-native', 'developer tools'>
avoid: <TODO: list of consultancies / brand-name body shops / industries you refuse to apply to>

fit_score_thresholds._doc: Each discovered job is scored 0-10 against your profile. >= auto_queue lands in jobs/queue for tailoring. Between candidate and auto_queue is borderline (surfaced but not auto-tailored). Below ignore is dropped silently.

discovery_sources.name: Hacker News Who's Hiring
discovery_sources.notes: Algolia HN API. Use curl + python3. Search latest 'Who is hiring' thread by title, then fetch comments via /items/<id>.

discovery_sources.name: RemoteOK
discovery_sources.notes: JSON API, first entry is metadata. Send User-Agent header. ~100 jobs returned, most US-only.

discovery_sources.name: Hasjob
discovery_sources.notes: Bangalore-heavy Indian product startup board. SSR HTML — WebFetch works. Refreshes weekly.

discovery_sources.name: WeWorkRemotely
discovery_sources.notes: SSR HTML works with WebFetch. Strong for international remote.

discovery_sources.name: YC Work at a Startup
discovery_sources.notes: React app — must use scripts/scrape-page.mjs. Drop the us_visa_required filter if you ARE US-authorized.

discovery_sources.name: Wellfound (AngelList)
discovery_sources.notes: BOT-PROTECTED via Cloudflare. Expect empty results from headless Chromium — skip with a note rather than fake data.

discovery_sources.name: Cuvette
discovery_sources.notes: India-focused, may require login for full listings. Try without first.

discovery_sources.name: Ashby boards (per-company)
discovery_sources.notes: Targeted per-company. Examples: baseten, fathom.video, mercor, ramp. Use when a source mentions an Ashby URL.

discovery_sources.name: Greenhouse boards (per-company)
discovery_sources.notes: Mostly static but some lazy-render. Use scrape-page to be safe.

discovery_sources.name: LinkedIn Jobs (public search)
discovery_sources.notes: Login wall blocks most details. Treat as supplementary only.
